query: SELECT id,ts,ts_nanos,level,target,feedback_log_body,thread_id,process_uuid FROM logs WHERE ts BETWEEN ? AND ? AND target IN ('codex_models_manager::cache','codex_models_manager::manager') ORDER BY id
limitation: immutable read does not include live WAL; absence of an upstream fetch event does not prove that no fetch occurred
confirmed: Child creation used list_models(refresh_strategy=offline) and cache hit with TTL 300 seconds.
